column1: CSS selectors for the element that holds the main content, separated by commas. The first one that matches is used. Supported: tag, #id, .class, [attribute] and [attribute=value], combined with a space or >.
column2: CSS selectors for the element that holds the main content, separated by commas. The first one that matches is used. Supported: tag, #id, .class, [attribute] and [attribute=value], combined with a space or >.

column2: CSS selectors of elements inside the main content that stay out of the Markdown, separated by commas: scripts, menus, forms, the sidebar. JSON-LD is always kept and added at the end.

column1: Start the Markdown with a YAML block holding the title, description and image of the page.
column2: Start the Markdown with a YAML block holding the title, description and image of the page.

column1: Add the structured data (JSON-LD) of the page at the end, in one json code block.
column2: Add the structured data (JSON-LD) of the page at the end, in one json code block.

column2: "Auto" links a file only when it exists in the web root (pub/). Choose "Yes" for a file a module serves through a route.

column2: Link to .well-known/ai-catalog.json (rel=ai-catalog), the Agentic Resource Discovery manifest: in the Link header and as a <link> in the HTML head.

column2: Link to .well-known/mcp/server-card.json (rel=describedby), the card of the shop's MCP server.

column2: URL of the XML sitemap (rel=sitemap), for example sitemap.xml. A relative URL is taken from the base URL. Empty sends no sitemap link.

column1: Link to the Markdown version of the page itself (rel=alternate, type=text/markdown). Only when the Markdown version is on.
column2: Link to the Markdown version of the page itself (rel=alternate, type=text/markdown). Only when the Markdown version is on.
